purpose: Teach: たべ/横たわっ/のる/盗み/名乗り/注が/申し述べ/惜しみ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お弁当をたべましょうね
lines.en: Sho, let's eat your bento together, okay?
lines.style: Warm, gentle invitation. Open softly on his name. Patient pace, like she's including him in something ordinary and safe. Slight upward lift at the end—reassurance, not question.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、芝生に横たわって雲を見たよ
lines.en: Mei-sister, I laid down on the grass and watched the clouds.
lines.style: Bright, unprompted sharing—he's bursting to tell her. Natural child cadence, quick and earnest. No performance, just pure observation offered up like a gift.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、自転車にのる時はヘルメットを忘れずにね
lines.en: Sho, don't forget your helmet when you ride your bike, okay?
lines.style: Gentle firmness. The 'okay' lands with quiet certainty—she means this. Caring underneath the instruction, not hovering. Matter-of-fact, the way someone who loves you keeps you safe.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お友達と盗みっこ遊びしたよ
lines.en: Mei-sister, I played a stealing game with my friend.
lines.style: Guileless, eager to share what he did. Light, unguarded tone—he doesn't realize this might need explanation. Child-simple delivery, trusting her to understand.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お友達にきちんと名乗りで自己紹介しましょうね
lines.en: Sho, when you play with friends, remember to introduce yourself properly, okay?
lines.style: Gentle redirection. Not scolding. A soft pause before 'remember'—she's helping him understand, not correcting him. Warm tone underneath the guidance.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お祖母ちゃんがお茶を注がれる時を見るのが好きだよ
lines.en: Mei-sister, I like watching Grandma pour the tea.
lines.style: Quiet, tender observation. He's noticed something small and precious. Soft, almost reverent pace. No hurry—he's sharing something delicate that matters to him.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんに自分の考えを申し述べてみてね
lines.en: Sho, tell me what you're thinking. Share your thoughts with Mei-sister, okay?
lines.style: Warm invitation to openness. Slight lean-in quality—she's making space for him to speak. Genuine curiosity in her voice. Encouraging without pressure.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お祖父ちゃんが時間を惜しみなく分けて下さって嬉しかった
lines.en: Mei-sister, I was so happy that Grandpa gave me his time—really gave it to me.
lines.style: Soft wonder, genuine emotion close to the surface. His voice steadies on 'so happy'—he's remembering something that moved him. Tender, unguarded, the way children sound when gratitude is still simple.
